events.title: Demo Update – Balancing & Tutorial
events.summary: A small update to make Knightstones easier to discover during Steam Next Fest:Added a tutorial explaining how to zoom in and out during battles.Increased deployment zone size from 3 to 4 to make combos easier to pull off.

events.title: DEVELOPMENT PROGRESS - AUGUST 2026
events.summary: Hello everyone,I hope you’ve all had a great summer.On my end, I’ve made some progress that I’m really happy to share with you!All Order Buildings Are ReadyThe Training Camp, which isn’t accessible in the demo, is finally finished. This building will allow you to passively generate Adepts by investing in training programs. events.title: Demo Intro Rework
events.summary: New update to discover Knightstones’ gameplay mechanics more quickly:The player now starts directly at the Mantis Fortress when starting a new game.The first visit to the Moon Goddess now takes place after the first run.The Moon Goddess has a slightly friendlier tone.Have fun!WillGreen

events.title: NEW TRAILER - GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW
events.summary: Hello everyone!I’m excited to share the new gameplay trailer for Knightstones!!I hope you won’t judge my terrible accent too harshly 😅 Feel free to like the video on YouTube and share it, it helps a lot!Thank you for all your wishlists and your reviews on the demo page! The journey continues. WillGreen

events.title: Hotfix #7 - Boss Fight & Deck viewer soft lock
events.summary: DebugRight-clicking during the Boss Fight is no longer possible.It is no longer possible to open the deck during the combat phase (and therefore cause a soft lock).Fixed recruitment buttons that could appear in the wrong position at the start of a run.

events.title: 🎉​ DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!

events.title: Dev diary #1 - Gameplay Overview
events.summary: Welcome!I’m Guillaume Lauer, aka WillGreen, the solo developer behind Knightstones. I started working on the game in late 2022 in my free time, and I have been developing it full time since September 2023.First of all, I invite you to join me on social media to follow this adventure. Subscribe to support my work and help me figure out the best way to share all the details of the development with you. Youtube Instagram Tiktok X Threads Now, let’s talk about the game!
